# ToolShoppy

> Free online utility tools. No signup, login or email required. File-processing tools run on the user's device.

## PDF editor

- [Free PDF Editor](https://toolshoppy.com/tools/pdf/editor/): Edit supported existing PDF text, add text, images and highlights, move or delete selected objects, rotate pages, and download the edited PDF.
- Editing and downloading are both free. No payment at export, subscription, trial expiry, credit card or added watermark.
- Processing is client-side. PDF, font and image files are not uploaded.
- The original PDF font is reused when character coverage is verified. Missing characters require a user-provided full TTF font or an explicitly selected replacement.
- Limits: PDFs up to 40 MB and 1,000 pages; bounded undo history. Scanned-text reconstruction, complex-script shaping, grouped-text editing and automatic paragraph reflow are not supported.
- This is not a secure document-redaction or sanitization tool. Shapes and highlights do not remove underlying content.
- This service does not claim feature parity with commercial desktop PDF editors or that every competing editor charges for downloads.
